entries.scenePrompt: Keep every cell of the LARGE BLUE TEN-BY-TEN-BY-TEN assembly unchanged. Only replace and reposition the separate small cube. Place it directly beside the nearest lower corner of the large assembly, separated by a small clear gap on the same ground plane, not far in the foreground. Its closest lower corner must be level with the large assembly's closest lower corner, and its closest upper vertical corner must be level with the top of the large assembly's bottom row, so the equal unit height is directly visible. The small cube's front and right faces follow exactly the same edge directions and approximate dimensions as ONE neighboring bottom-row unit cell: about55px high, front about50px wide, right about35px wide in this1086px-wide target. Make it a normal cube matching the existing small cells, with plain blue material and a subtle grounding shadow. Do not change the large cube's grid or add a gap/removed block to that assembly. No ruler, line overlay, lettering, numerals or arrows. This is a unit-size comparison for the textbook million-to-billion ratio, not additional units inside the large assembly.
